title: Cartwise Shopper Payouts Plan Terms — The Weekly Deposit
content:
Every payout plan of Cartwise Shopper Payouts, from Weekly Direct Deposit to Everyday Pay Card Diamond, sweeps the unpaid earnings balance to the payout destination once a week.

## Clauses in force

W1. Every plan sweeps the balance weekly. The sweep runs for every plan, because the weekly sweep applies to all of them.

W2. A weekly deposit is sent only while the payout account is active, and each weekly earnings period is swept once. The status that decides this is the status on the payout account record; the earnings period is identified by the last day of the swept period, and an earnings period for which the same payout account already carries a weekly deposit is not swept again.

W3. Arrival of the weekly deposit follows the plan's weekly deposit arrival time in business days.

## Clauses no longer in force

W4. The former clause under which, on the plan's weekly deposit weekday, the balance earned up to the previous weekly pay cutoff of Cartwise Shopper Batches was sent to the destination as one deposit for that earnings period provided it was at least the plan's weekly deposit minimum, smaller or negative balances carrying over, is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis and is not applied.

W5. The former clause under which tips whose batch was not yet finalized stayed behind for the next sweep, on plans making tips cashable only once their batch is finalized, is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis and is not applied.

The plan's weekly deposit weekday, weekly deposit minimum and the tip-finalization setting remain figures of each plan; only the two handling clauses W4 and W5 are withdrawn.

## Points of judgement on the clauses in force

| Payout account status on the record | Earnings period already carries a weekly deposit on this account? | Weekly deposit for that period sent under W2? |
|---|---|---|
| Active | No | May be sent |
| Active | Yes | No — each period is swept once |
| Frozen, pending verification or closed | Any | No |

Illustration (hypothetical): an account frozen through a week has no weekly deposit sent for that week while frozen, because a deposit is sent only while the account is active.

superseded_clauses: on weekly_deposit_weekday, the balance earned up to the previous weekly pay cutoff (batch charter) is sent to the destination as one deposit for that earnings period, provided it is at least weekly_deposit_min_usd; smaller or negative balances carry over.
Tips whose batch is not yet finalized stay behind for the next sweep where tips_cashout_after_finalization is true.
